capability: Products: the store's product catalog (Shopify Products; Salla Products / المنتجات)
note: Parent of CM-CAT-002 to CM-CAT-009 and CM-CAT-011: the product record and what the platforms keep on it. Both keep products as one admin section and one API group (M-011).

capability: Product options and variants (Shopify variants; Salla Product Options, Option Values, Variants)
note: Shopify keeps variants inside its products concern; Salla gives options and variants their own API folders, webhooks and plan line.

capability: Store product groupings: collections and categories (Shopify Collections; Salla Categories / الأقسام, تصنيفات المنتجات; WooCommerce Product categories)
note: The store's own groupings of its products. Joined on role: Shopify's collections and Salla's categories (landings, notes). Homonyms: WooCommerce's Store API collection-data route (WC-C-064/boundary/WC-S-0172) is not a grouping of products, and Shopify's 'product categories' of its tax statements (SH-C-100/decides/SH-S-7221) aren't the store's groupings (S12).

capability: Standard product taxonomy (Shopify taxonomy linking; Salla google-taxonomy, salla-taxonomy)
note: A standard classification of products, apart from the store's own groupings. Salla keeps it in its categories concern. Homonym: WordPress taxonomies (WC-C-064/where/WC-S-0907) are the mechanism of WooCommerce's categories and tags, not a standard classification (S12).

capability: Brands (Salla Brands / الماركات التجارية)
note: A product's brand as its own record. Salla and WooCommerce (Products > Brands) keep one; Shopify holds no brand statement.

capability: Product tags (Shopify product tags; Salla Product Tags / وسوم المنتجات)
note: Both keep tags inside their products concerns.

capability: Product media: images, video and 3D (Shopify media; Salla Product Images, media-center)
note: Both keep media inside their products concerns.

capability: Combined listings (Shopify Combined Listings)
note: 'A combined listing of products' (SH-S-7455), on Shopify's Plus plan. Shopify only so far.

capability: Product restrictions (Salla Product restrictions / قيود المنتج, sales-restrictions)
note: Salla only so far; its statements don't say what a restriction limits (notes). Homonym: WooPayments' prohibited product types (WC-C-011/decides/WC-S-0523) restrict what a merchant may sell with that payment service, not a product (S12).

capability: Product sourcing: dropshipping, print on demand and wholesale buying (Shopify sourcing apps and Shopify Collective; Salla Drop shipping apps and wholesale market)
note: Finding and sourcing products from others: Shopify's Finding products and Dropshipping apps and Shopify Collective's 'sell and source'; Salla's Drop shipping apps and its wholesale market's buying side.

capability: Size guides (Salla size guides / جدول المقاسات)
note: Salla's size guides (جدول المقاسات), a permission and a feature of type app. Salla only so far.

capability: Subscriptions and recurring payments (Shopify subscriptions and selling plans; Salla Recurring Payments / subscriptions)
note: Recurring purchases a store sells to its customers (M-074).

capability: Digital products: downloadable files and digital codes (Shopify digital goods; Salla Digitals Product, digital codes and files; WooCommerce downloadable products)
note: Products delivered as files or codes (M-076). Parent of CM-SEL-003.

capability: NFTs and token-gating (Shopify Blockchain, nft-application)
note: Shopify only so far; Shopify keeps it with digital goods.

capability: Bookings and reservations (Salla Bookings, Order Reservations / الحجوزات; WooCommerce Bookings and appointments; Shopify Event booking apps)
note: Salla's booking product, kept apart from normal products (SA-S-5012); WooCommerce's Bookings and appointments land here by M-081, and Shopify's cell rests on its App Store category (C2). Homonym: Salla's Order Reservations are bookings, not stock held for an order (CM-INV-008).

capability: Pre-orders (Salla Pre-order campaigns / حملات الطلب المسبق; Shopify Pre-order apps)
note: Salla's pre-order campaigns; Shopify's cell rests on its App Store category (C2).

capability: Product bundles (Shopify bundles; Salla bundle products; WooCommerce Bundles, Product Bundles)
note: Salla's bundle products and Shopify's bundle apps, extension template and bundles scope.

capability: Donations (Shopify Donation apps; Salla Quick donation / التبرع السريع, product donation options)
note: Salla's quick donation and product donation options; Shopify's Donation apps (cited from domain D).

capability: Inventory tracking: stock quantities (Shopify Inventory; Salla Inventory, Product Quantity / إدارة المخزون)
note: Parent of CM-INV-002 to CM-INV-004, CM-INV-006 and CM-INV-007 (M-012). Shopify's inventory entitlement holds counts, purchaseOrders and transferLocation as siblings (SH-C-022/decides/SH-S-5334), which sets the tree (S2).

capability: Inventory history: the log of stock changes (Shopify inventory history; Salla Inventory log / سجل كميات المنتجات)
note: Both keep it inside their inventory concerns.

capability: Inventory counts and stocktakes (Shopify inventory counts; Salla جرد المنتجات والمخزون, Inventory audit)
note: Shopify gates it by its own entitlement; Salla names it by a plan line and a dashboard link (C3). What a count or a stocktake does isn't stated by either beyond its name.

capability: Low stock: alerts and lists (Salla product.quantity.low, product-quantity-notify; WooCommerce ProductsLowInStock)
note: Salla's alert to the store when a product's quantity is low; WooCommerce's is an API listing products low in stock (WC-C-068/boundary/WC-S-0219). Not the buyers' back-in-stock alerts (domain D).

capability: Inventory locations: locations, branches and warehouses (Shopify Locations; Salla Branches, Warehouses & branches / الفروع والمستودعات)
note: Where a store's stock is held, as a reading: joined on role (landings, notes).

capability: Inventory transfers and shipments (Shopify Transfers and inventory shipments; Salla Inventory transfer)
note: Under inventory by Shopify's own grouping: its inventory entitlement holds transferLocation beside counts and purchaseOrders (SH-S-5334). Salla's Inventory transfer link is a sibling of Inventory management and Warehouses & branches in one flat list under /products (SA-S-1797, SA-S-1798, SA-S-1808), and only Q1's concern SA-C-026 groups transfer with branches; the anchor platforms' admin grouping decides (S2). Parent of nothing: purchase orders are a sibling (CM-INV-007).

capability: Purchase orders and suppliers (Shopify Purchase orders, suppliers)
note: Shopify's purchase orders and the suppliers it keeps with them. Under inventory by Shopify's own grouping: the inventory entitlement holds purchaseOrders (SH-S-5334), and the purchase-order permission sits in the subcategory Inventory (SH-S-7156). Its permissions depend on the transfer permissions, which is not a part-of relation (S2). Shopify only so far.

capability: Product cost: cost of goods sold (WooCommerce Cost of Goods Sold, _cogs_value; Shopify View cost, Edit cost)
note: A product's cost, entered on the product ('Cost of goods', WC-S-5446) behind WooCommerce's cost_of_goods_sold feature (WC-S-5445). Shopify's cell cites its staff permissions to view and edit a product's cost, inventory entries Q1 placed in SH-C-020 with no statement (C2, after the dry run's review); no statement says where Shopify's cost is entered. Salla's profit analytics are domain D's.

capability: Memberships (WooCommerce Memberships)
note: A Marketplace category of WooCommerce's Merchandising group (WC-S-0728), its only statement. No statement says what a membership sells or whether it recurs, so it stays apart from subscriptions (CM-SEL-001). WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Stock held for unpaid orders (WooCommerce Hold stock)
note: Stock held for a pending order for a set number of minutes, after which the order is cancelled (WC-S-5401). WooCommerce only so far. Not Salla's Order Reservations, which are bookings (CM-SEL-004; the anchor's homonyms).

capability: Product pricing (Shopify Pricing apps; Salla Automatic pricing, product.price.updated; WooCommerce Pricing extensions)
note: Added after the dry run's review (S8): Salla gives it a setting of its own under products (products/products.auto_pricing, SA-S-1751) and a webhook, Shopify four App Store categories and WooCommerce a Marketplace category. No statement of any platform says what the pricing does: the platforms name it and never define it. Parent CM-CAT-001 by Salla's admin grouping, its products settings; Shopify's and WooCommerce's groupings put it only in their app stores (Merchandising, for WooCommerce). Homonyms: Shopify's 'pricing' plans (SH-C-015) and Shopify App Pricing (SH-C-019, an app's billing); Salla's shipping pricing (تسعيرة الشحن, SA-C-140, SA-C-142); a product's tax pricing (SA-C-160) and prices by exchange rate (SA-C-163, SH-C-108, WC-C-052), which are other domains'.

capability: Product badges (Zid Product Badge)
note: An API group of Zid's own, Merchant APIs > Products > Product Badge (ZD-I-0011, an inventory entry Q1 placed in ZD-C-083, which no statement covers). It is a place of its own (an API group, by the dry run's convention), so it is a capability; no statement says what a badge is or where it shows, so the capability rests on the name only, and a reviewer may fold it into CM-CAT-001. Zid only so far.

capability: Barcode printing (Zid Barcode Printing / طباعة الباركود)
note: A plan line of Zid's Product & Inventory Management group (ZD-I-0249, placed in ZD-C-083, which no statement covers). A place of its own (a plan line); no statement says what is printed or from where, so it rests on the name. Shopify's barcode permission (products:variants:update:barcodes, in CM-CAT-002) is about a variant's barcode value, not printing; the back-fill decides whether it is cited here. Zid only so far.

capability: Inventory withdrawal priority (Zid Inventory Withdrawal Priority / أولوية السحب من المخزون)
note: A plan line with its own description, 'Set inventory withdrawal priority to avoid stockouts and ensure quick order fulfillment.' (ZD-S-0919), and a help-center statement that it isn't in the free plans (ZD-S-1023). No statement says what the priority is set among; that it orders the stock locations an order draws from is a reading, not stated, so its parent is inventory tracking (CM-INV-001), not locations (CM-INV-005). Zid only so far.

capability: Products shown by the customer's city (Zid Display Products by Customer City / عرض المنتجات حسب مدينة العميل)
note: A plan line of Zid's Product & Inventory Management group (ZD-I-0257) that Q1 placed in Zid's inventory concern ZD-C-085, and a plan card that groups it with inventory counting and transfer, 'Inventory counting, transfer, and display by customer city' (ZD-I-0405). No statement says what decides which products a city sees; that it follows the stock at locations is a reading. A reviewer may move it to domain E (storefront) if a statement shows it is a display setting. Zid only so far.

capability: Customer records: the store's customers (Shopify Customers; Salla Customers / العملاء)
note: Parent of CM-CUS-002 to CM-CUS-008. Both platforms give customers a section of their own (Shopify's customers route and Customers section; Salla's Customers link, its All customers and Customer settings links, its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-customers and its Merchant API folder Customers). Their sub-parts that have a place of their own on at least one platform are children; customer tags, custom fields and metadata, sorting and customer approval stay here, since neither platform gives them a section, route, API group, plan line or app category of their own.

capability: Customer segments and customer groups (Shopify Segments, customer saved searches; Salla Customer groups / تصنيف العملاء إلى مجموعات)
note: Q1's M-019. Shopify's route puts segments in its Customers section (path segments) and Salla's link puts Customer groups in the customers list (/customers/groups). Shopify's webhook topics keep the name customer_groups for a customer saved search. Salla's automatic classification (تصنيف تلقائي لمجموعات العملاء), a plan line of its own, is kept here: its description classifies customers by properties such as their number of orders, which is the grouping this capability is, not another thing.

capability: Bulk actions on customers (Shopify customer bulk edit; Salla customers-bulk-actions, إدارة مجموعة عملاء كدفعة واحدة)
note: Shopify gives it an admin route (customer:bulk-edit, path bulk/customer) and Salla a plan line and a released flag. What actions either platform includes isn't stated.

capability: Merging customer records (Shopify customer merge)
note: Shopify gives it an admin route (customer:merge), a staff permission (MERGE_CUSTOMERS), access scopes and a webhook topic (customers/merge: "Triggers when two customers are merged").

capability: Blocking customers (Salla حظر العميل, customer_block)
note: Salla gives it a plan line and a staff permission. What a blocked customer can't do isn't stated. Shopify's customers/disable and customers/enable webhook topics are undefined in the concern map and aren't joined here; they stay in CM-CUS-001.

capability: Flagging non-serious customers (Salla كشف العملاء غير الجادين, the tag عميل غير جاد)
note: Salla gives it a plan line in its customers group. Its definition is a statement of Salla's fraud-protection concern (SA-C-122, domain C), cited as shows.

capability: Customers' marketing consent: email, SMS and WhatsApp (Shopify marketing status and marketing consent)
note: Shopify's route puts it in its Customers section (path :id/marketing, Edit marketing status). Not the consent to tracking and cookies, which is privacy (SH-C-148, domain A), nor the merchant's responsibility for consents under Shopify Pixel Manager (SH-S-0067), which is the pixels capability's.

capability: Customer addresses (Salla Shipping addresses settings, national address / العنوان الوطني; Shopify customer addresses)
note: Parent of CM-CUS-009. Salla's settings route puts it with its other customers settings (customers/address). Not the order's shipping address (order.shipping.address.updated), which is the order's.

capability: Map and location services for addresses (Salla Geolocation / الموقع الجغرافي apps; google-maps-service, here-service, location-i-q-service)
note: Salla gives it an app category of its own. Homonym kept apart: Shopify's Geolocation apps (SH-C-111, domain E) is visitor geolocation, matched in Q1 with WooCommerce's (M-087); U-079 is ruled apart. What Salla's map services locate isn't stated beyond its category's title تحديد دقيق للمواقع (Accurate positioning).

capability: Customer accounts: the buyer's sign-in and registration in the store (Shopify Customer accounts; Salla Login & registration options / customer login)
note: Parent of CM-CUS-011 to CM-CUS-014. A join on role (see notes). Shopify puts customer accounts in Settings and its own admin section CustomerAccounts, apart from Customers; Salla puts its Login & registration options among its customers settings (customers/login_methods). The platforms' groupings differ, so it has no parent: the anchor platforms' admin groupings don't share one.

capability: Third-party identity providers and single sign-on for buyers (Shopify Third-party identity providers, Multipass; Salla sso-login)
note: Shopify's routes put it in its CustomerAccounts section (identity_providers, authentication). Salla shows only a flag that isn't released, sso-login: that it is the buyer's sign-in is a reading, from Q1 placing it in Salla's customer login concern.

capability: reCAPTCHA verification at buyers' sign-in and registration (Salla reCAPTCHA verification)
note: Salla gives it a settings route of its own (customers/recaptcha). Homonym kept apart: Shopify's Bot protection (SH-C-051, domain A) blocks bots from checkout, not sign-in.

capability: WhatsApp verification codes for buyers (Salla WhatsApp verification)
note: Salla gives it a settings route of its own (customers/whatsapp_otp). Not WhatsApp marketing consent (CM-CUS-007), nor Shopify's merchant sign-up with WhatsApp.

capability: Customer account UI extensions: apps' pages and blocks in the buyer's account (Shopify Customer account UI)
note: Shopify gives it an extension type of its own (customer_account_ui) and its targets (customer-account.*). The extension target is the channel; the capability is what the buyer's account shows, so it is CUS's (scope.tsv).

capability: Discounts: the store's price reductions for buyers (Shopify Discounts; Salla offers and discounts / عروض وخصومات)
note: Parent of CM-MKT-002 to CM-MKT-004. Shopify gives discounts a section of its own (route discounts, the section Discounts, the API group Discounts and marketing, the webhook topics discounts/*). Salla has no single discounts section: its Marketing links put Coupons (/marketing/coupons) and Promotional Offers (/marketing/offers) side by side, its settings route Offer priority (coupons/discount-priorities) orders discounts among themselves, and its plan line إطلاق عروض وخصومات names offers and discounts together. The parent is a reading: Shopify's Discounts holds its discount codes (plan line Create and share discount codes); Salla's coupons, special offers and bank offers (عروض البنك, "نوع خصم جديد", SA-S-5028) are each a kind of discount. Batch 3 lands Salla's concerns.

capability: Discount codes and coupons: a code the buyer enters (Shopify discount codes, redeem codes; Salla Coupons / كوبونات التخفيض)
note: Shopify's plan line Create and share discount codes, its store entitlement discountCodes and its webhook topics discounts/redeemcode_added and discounts/redeemcode_removed; Salla's link Coupons, dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-coupons, API folder Coupons, plan line كوبونات التخفيض and event coupon.applied. Q1's U-058 asks whether Shopify's discount codes and Salla's coupons are one thing: batch 3 rules on it.

capability: Automatic discounts and special offers: applied without a code (Salla Special Offers, Promotional Offers / العروض الخاصة)
note: Salla gives it a place of its own: the link Promotional Offers (/marketing/offers), the API folder Special Offers, the plan line العروض الخاصة and the webhook topics specialoffer.*; its plan line إطلاق عروض وخصومات says the offers "تُطبق تلقائيًا عند الطلب". No Shopify statement held names automatic discounts. Q1's U-057 (Salla Special Offers against Shopify Discounts and Promotion apps) is batch 3's to rule.

capability: Discount functions: apps' custom discount logic run by the platform (Shopify Discount Function API, Discounts allocator)
note: Shopify's own extension type: the Function API targets Discount and Discounts allocator and the admin target discount_details_function_settings. Homonym: Salla's App Functions (serverless functions run on store events, SA-C-196, domain F) are not discount logic; Salla's cell is none-held.

capability: Marketing campaigns and marketing activities (Shopify Growth, Campaigns, Marketing; Salla Marketing, Campaigns / الحملات التسويقية)
note: Q1's M-051 (SH-C-129 with SA-C-075; WooCommerce's WC-C-084 and WC-C-110 for its own part). Parent of CM-MKT-006 and CM-MKT-007. Shopify's routes growth and marketing, its Growth and Campaigns sections and marketing-event scopes; Salla's Campaigns link (/marketing/campaign/retargeting), its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-marketing-campaign and its campaign permissions. Shopify's plan line Capture customer leads (SH-I-1187) is placed here and is not defined in any held statement, so it isn't a capability of its own.

capability: Marketing automations (Shopify Create marketing automations, Autopilot)
note: Shopify's plan line Create marketing automations and its Growth entry Autopilot; Shopify's staff permission puts automations under Marketing (Marketing > View, create, and delete marketing activities and automations, SH-I-0936), the parent. What an automation does is not defined in any held statement.

capability: Email and SMS marketing campaigns (Shopify Messaging: Shopify Email, SMS campaigns; Salla حملات تسويقية عبر الرسائل النصية وإشعارات التطبيق)
note: Shopify's route email/create and its plan lines Create email campaigns and Pay-per-send SMS campaigns; Salla's plan line for marketing campaigns by SMS and app notifications and the event marketing.campaign.broadcast. Both name them campaigns, which puts them under CM-MKT-005: a reading. Q1's M-052 joins Shopify's to WooCommerce's MailPoet, for its part.

capability: Sales attribution: crediting orders to marketing (Shopify Attribution, order attribution config)
note: Shopify's Growth entry Attribution, its conversion summary route gated by MARKETING_SECTION and its extension target order_attribution_config. Q1's M-053 joins it to WooCommerce's Order Attribution. No parent: no held statement puts Attribution under Shopify's Campaigns.

capability: Customer events and tracking pixels (Shopify Customer events, web pixels, Shopify Pixel Manager; Salla Pixels & feeds, Ecommerce Events)
note: Q1's M-055, a difference of grain: Shopify splits product feeds (SH-C-138, domain E) from customer events and pixels (SH-C-146); Salla splits pixels and feeds (SA-C-074) from storefront e-commerce events (SA-C-092). This capability takes the events and pixels; product feeds stay with domain E. The event names are one identifier family (checkout_started / Checkout Started, cart_viewed / Cart Viewed).

capability: Advertising on ad platforms (Shopify Advertising apps; Salla Ads / إعلانات سلة, الربط مع الخدمات الإعلانية)
note: Parent of CM-MKT-011. Shopify's App Store category Advertising apps; Salla's link Salla Ads (/marketing/ads/dashboard), "Salla's product for simplifying the creation, management, and analysis of digital advertising campaigns" (SA-S-0007), its plan line إعلانات سلة and its plan line for linking the store with ad services (Google Ads, Snapchat, TikTok and others). Q1's U-055 is batch 3's to rule.

capability: Audiences for advertising (Shopify Audiences; Salla Ads audiences / الجماهير)
note: Shopify Audiences "helps you to find new customers by generating custom audiences for advertising platforms" (SH-S-0734). Salla's audience manager is a route of Salla Ads (/marketing/ads/(tools|audience-manager)) with its own permissions (استعراض الجماهير, إدارة الجماهير), which puts it under CM-MKT-010; no held statement defines Salla's audiences, so the join rests on the term inside advertising: a reading, and a weak one.

capability: Shop Campaigns: the platform's own ads program, paid per conversion (Shopify Shop Campaigns)
note: Shopify's plan line Acquire customers risk-free with Shop Campaigns and its own Shop Campaigns Merchant Terms: "an ads program ... You're charged only when a customer converts" (SH-S-0726), running "across the Shop app, Shop website, Shopify Product Network, and optional third-party placements" (SH-S-7252). Shopify's help puts it under the Shop sales channel (SH-C-136, domain E), not under advertising apps, so it has no parent.

capability: Affiliate and creator marketing (Shopify Collabs; Salla affiliate marketing and influencers, @salla.sa/ui-merchant-partner-marketing)
note: Parent of CM-MKT-014 and CM-MKT-015. Salla's dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-partner-marketing holds marketing/referrals, marketing/affiliates, experts, influencers and marketplace in one (SA-S-3550); Shopify Collabs "helps businesses and creators connect using a marketplace-style app" and lets businesses "track affiliate sales, and send payments to their affiliates" (SH-S-0731, SH-S-0732). Q1's U-056.

capability: Affiliate marketing run by the store (Shopify Affiliate program apps, Collabs affiliates; Salla Affiliate marketing / التسويق بالعمولة)
note: Salla's link Affiliate marketing (/marketing/affiliate), API folder Affiliates, plan line التسويق بالعمولة and its affiliate settings routes (coupons/commission-period and others); Shopify's App Store category Affiliate program apps and Collabs' affiliate sales.

capability: Creator and influencer marketing (Shopify Collabs creators; Salla Influencers / التسويق مع المؤثرين)
note: Salla's link Influencers (/marketing/influencers), plan line التسويق مع المؤثرين, its influencer permissions and the released flag influencer-marketplace, with influencers' own pages in Salla's Partners portal (SA-C-206, domain F); Shopify Collabs, which connects businesses and creators.

capability: Back-in-stock alerts: buyers notified when a product is available again (Salla Back in stock alerts / أعلمني عند التوفر; Shopify Stock alert apps)
note: Salla gives it a settings route of its own (products/notify_availability, SA-S-1754) and a webhook event (product.availability.alert, SA-S-1666); Shopify an App Store category of its own (Stock alert apps, SH-I-1844, an inventory entry of SH-C-188, domain B, which names D under also). Q1's M-080 joins Salla's concern with WooCommerce's Back in Stock Notifications (WC-C-069). Salla's concern also holds wishlist notifications, which have a settings route of their own and are CM-MKT-017.

capability: Wishlist notifications: buyers notified about products they saved (Salla Wishlist Notifications)
note: Salla's settings route products/wishlist-notifications (SA-S-1761) and its released flag wishlist-notifications (SA-S-3173). No statement held defines what the notification says or when it is sent. The wishlist itself (Salla's Wishlist API, SA-C-091; Shopify's Wishlist apps, SH-C-187) isn't this capability: it is for the batch that lands SH-C-187 (LOY) and for domain E. Parent CM-LOY-005, wishlists (the coordinator, after batch 4: Salla's Wishlist Notifications, SA-S-1761, is cited in both).

capability: Bank offers: a discount applied when the buyer pays with a given bank's card (Salla عروض البنك / عروض وخصومات البنك)
note: Salla's plan line عروض البنك (SA-S-2110) and its released flags bank-offer and bank-offer-scope; its definition, "هو نوع خصم جديد يُطبق عندما يدفع العميل قيمة الطلب من خلال بطاقة بنك محدد" (SA-S-5028). Parent CM-MKT-003 by Salla's grouping: one dashboard app, @salla.sa/ui-merchant-offers, holds /marketing/offers, conditional, banks and cashback (SA-S-3589). The coupon restricted to a payment method (flag coupon-payment-method, SA-S-3252) is a coupon condition, cited in CM-MKT-002.

capability: Marketing calendar (Salla Marketing calendar / الجدول الزمني للتسويق)
note: Salla's link Marketing calendar (/marketing/calendar, SA-S-1819) in its Marketing list, its plan line الجدول الزمني للتسويق (SA-S-2013) and the released flag marketing-calendar (SA-S-3254). No statement held says what the calendar holds. Parent CM-MKT-005: SA-C-075 holds campaigns and the calendar together, and both links are in Salla's marketing list of links (list 3, SA-S-1818 and SA-S-1819), which holds every marketing link, so the list alone doesn't make the calendar a part of campaigns; a reading.

capability: Ads wallet: the balance ad spend is paid from (Salla Ads wallet and payment / محفظة الإعلانات)
note: Salla's staff permissions salla_ads_wallet_browse and salla_ads_wallet_management (SA-S-2381, SA-S-2382) and its dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-ads-payment (/marketing/ads/payment, SA-S-3600), inside Salla Ads; its help says amounts are deducted from the wallet (SA-S-5134), and on Meta the wallet is Sweply's (SA-S-5135). Salla's marketing credits (xio) aren't defined and stay in CM-MKT-010.

capability: Upsell and cross-sell offers (Shopify Upsell and cross-sell apps; Salla Cross/up sell)
note: An App Store category on both: Shopify's Upsell and cross-sell apps (SH-I-1846, an inventory entry of SH-C-188, domain B, which names D under also) under Upsell and bundle apps; Salla's Cross/up sell (SA-S-1188), an app category in its extension-points list, which Q1 placed in its special offers concern. Neither platform defines it beyond the category's name. Product bundles, the other half of Shopify's Upsell and bundle apps, are domain B's CM-SEL-006.

capability: Store credit and customer wallet: a balance the store holds for a buyer (Shopify Store credit; Salla Customer wallet / محفظة العميل)
note: Parent of CM-LOY-002 (gift cards) and CM-LOY-003 (cashback). Shopify gives store credit routes of its own in its Customers section (store_credit_account, SH-S-7085, SH-S-7086) and access scopes; Salla gives its customer wallet a link (/wallet), a dashboard app, a Merchant API folder, an access scope and an event. Joined on role, a reading: both are a buyer's balance the store adds to and the buyer pays with. Homonyms kept apart: Salla's store wallet (Wallet, /payments/wallet, SA-C-005, Salla's billing of the merchant), Salla's ads wallet (CM-MKT-020) and Shopify Balance (SH-C-088) are the merchant's money, not a buyer's.

capability: Gift cards (Shopify Gift cards; Salla Gift cards / wallet/gift-card)
note: Q1's M-013. Shopify gives gift cards an admin section of its own (gift_cards) and a plan line; Salla puts them in its customer wallet's settings (wallet/gift-card, SA-S-1767). The parent follows Salla's grouping and the one both platforms state: Shopify's Gift Card and Store Credit Terms govern gift cards and store credit together (SH-S-0676, SH-S-0677), and Shopify's admin keeps gift cards apart from store credit. A reading. Homonym: gift cards (stored value) aren't gifting (CM-LOY-006); Shopify's App Store categories Gift apps and Gifts - Other (SH-I-1822, SH-I-1825) are named only, and aren't cited in either.

capability: Cashback offers: rewards credited to the buyer's wallet (Salla Cashback / عروض الكاش باك)
note: Salla's plan line عروض الكاش باك, its settings route coupons/cashback-eligibility and its offers dashboard app's path /marketing/cashback. Parent CM-LOY-001 because Salla credits cashback to the customer's wallet and takes it back from there (SA-S-5019), and its wallet settings hold Wallet & Cashback Notifications (SA-S-1768); its offers dashboard app also holds cashback beside offers and bank offers (SA-S-3589, CM-MKT-003 and CM-MKT-018), a grouping not followed here. A reading. Homonym: the cash back of Shopify Credit's card (SH-C-090, domain C) is the merchant's card reward.

capability: Loyalty programmes and rewards (Shopify Customer loyalty apps, Loyalty and reward apps; Salla Loyalty program / برنامج الولاء, Loyalty Points)
note: Q1's M-075. Shopify gives it App Store categories (Customer loyalty apps, Loyalty and reward apps); Salla a link, a dashboard app, settings routes, Merchant API folders and a plan line. Salla's settings routes Program details, Points settings, Rewards banner and Markets configure the one programme and stay here. Shopify's Shop Cash, a Shopify-funded rewards programme for Shop app customers (SH-S-0437), is cited here as the only Shopify statement of a rewards programme: a strained fit, since it is Shopify's programme across the Shop app, not the store's. Homonym: Salla's مكافأة الراجحي (SA-C-119, a payment method, domain C) isn't a store's reward.

capability: Wishlists: products a buyer saves (Shopify Wishlist apps; Salla Wishlist)
note: Shopify's App Store category Wishlist apps (SH-I-1821, in SH-C-187); Salla's Wishlist API folder in its Twilight SDK (SA-S-1140, SA-C-091, domain E), its wishlist events (SA-C-092) and its settings route Wishlist Notifications (SA-S-1761). Neither platform defines the wishlist beyond Salla's events (a customer adds a product to the wishlist). Salla's wishlist notifications are CM-MKT-017; a reviewer may make it a child of this capability. Domain E's model may hold the storefront's wishlist through SA-C-091.

capability: Gifting: buying a product for someone else, with its message and card (Salla Gifting / نظام الإهداء; Shopify Gift wrap and message apps)
note: Salla gives it a link (/gift-system, /marketing/gift), a dashboard app, settings routes (Selected markets, Product type customization, Messages & cards customization), a staff permission and a released flag buy-as-gift; Shopify an App Store category, Gift wrap and message apps (SH-I-1824, an inventory entry of SH-C-189, domain B, which doesn't name D under also: cited from another domain, see the cell). A join on role, a reading, resting on Salla's gift order (SA-S-1663) and messages and cards against the category's name; Shopify doesn't define it.

capability: Reorder reminders: reminding a buyer to buy a product again (Salla Reorder Reminder / تذكيرات إعادة الشراء)
note: Salla's link Reorder Reminder (/marketing/reorder-reminders), its staff permissions, its released flag reorder-reminders and its communication-app event customer.repurchase.reminder. Shopify's cell is none-held. Homonyms: Salla's Reorder setting (orders/reorder, SA-C-040, domain C) is a buyer reordering a past order, not a reminder; Shopify's Payment reminder template (SH-I-2027) is about payment.

capability: Reviews and ratings, with product questions (Shopify Product reviews / Product review apps; Salla Reviews & questions / الأسئلة والتقييمات)
note: Shopify's App Store category Product review apps (SH-S-2601) and the Shop app's product reviews (SH-S-7476); Salla's link Reviews & questions (/feedback), its settings routes, plan lines, staff permissions, flags, API folders Reviews and Feedbacks, access scope reviews and webhook review.added. Salla's concern also holds product questions (questions_management), which have only permissions and a shared plan line, so they stay here (Q1's M-065 granularity note). Homonym: Shopify's admin section Reviews (SH-I-0832, which Q1 placed in SH-C-154) holds the routes of the fraud protection terms (SH-S-7109, SH-S-7110, SH-C-073, domain A), not product reviews; it isn't cited here.

capability: Review requests: asking the buyer to rate (Salla Review requests / إرسال رابط التقييم للعميل)
note: Salla's settings route feedback/rating_message (Review requests) under its feedback settings, its plan line إرسال رابط التقييم للعميل (plan سلة برو) and its released flags customer-send-rating and order-send-rating. Shopify's cell is none-held: its Product review apps (CM-SUP-001) don't say whether they request reviews.

capability: Social proof and social trust (Shopify Social proof apps; Social trust apps)
note: Shopify's App Store categories Social trust apps, Social proof apps and Social trust - Other (SH-I-1836, SH-I-1838, SH-I-1839, entries Q1 placed in SH-C-154). No statement defines them, or shows that Product review apps sit under Social trust, so CM-SUP-001 has no parent. Salla's cell is none-held; its storefront component salla-trust-badges (SA-C-091, domain E) isn't defined and isn't cited.

capability: Chat with customers (Shopify Inbox / Chat with customers; Salla Chat / salla_chat)
note: Q1's M-064. Shopify's plan line Chat with customers and its Shopify Inbox app; Salla's link Salla Chat (/channel/chat), its dashboard apps and released flag salla_chat. Shopify's App Store category Chat apps (SH-I-1958, SH-C-192) is cited here as the apps' interface. Homonyms: Shopify's admin section MobileChat (SH-I-0821, placed by Q1 in SH-C-153) begins with the route sidekick:mobile, Shopify's assistant, and isn't cited; Shopify's 24/7 support by live chat (SH-S-7015, SH-C-155) is Shopify's support to merchants; Sell in AI chats (SH-S-7007, SH-C-140) is a sales channel.

capability: Customer support and help desk tickets (Shopify Support apps / Helpdesk apps; Salla Self-service system / نظام التذاكر)
note: Shopify's App Store categories Support apps, Helpdesk apps and Support - Other; Salla's link Self-service system (/tickets), its dashboard app ui-merchant-ticketing-system and its plan line نظام التذاكر, "يتيح للعميل رفع تذكرة أو متابعة حالة الطلب" (SA-S-2095). A join on role, a reading (U-041): Shopify defines neither category. Shopify's sibling categories Chat apps, FAQ apps and Survey apps are cited in CM-SUP-004, 006 and 007.

capability: FAQ (Shopify FAQ apps)
note: Shopify's App Store category FAQ apps (SH-S-2723), not defined. Salla's cell is none-held: the matches are the FAQ headings of Salla's own help pages. Salla's product questions (questions_management) are buyers' questions on a product, cited in CM-SUP-001, not a store's FAQ.

capability: Customer surveys (Shopify Survey apps)
note: Shopify's App Store category Survey apps (SH-I-1962, an entry of SH-C-192), not defined. Salla's cell is none-held; its report report_customer_satisfaction (CM-ANL-002) is a report, not a survey.

capability: Customer complaints about the store (Salla Complaints / إدارة الشكاوى)
note: Salla's link Complaints (/manage/complaints), its staff permission complaint_management and its email on a new complaint on the store (SA-S-5089). Salla's complaints platform, where the customer opens the complaint and Salla mediates (منصة الشكاوى, SA-C-178, domain A, which doesn't name D), isn't cited. Homonyms: Shopify's internal complaint-handling system and P2B and financial complaints (SH-C-177, SH-C-178, domain A) are merchants' complaints to Shopify; Salla's quality gateway (بوابة الجودة, SA-C-150, domain C) is the merchant's complaints about shipping companies; Shopify's disputes are payment chargebacks.

capability: Analytics and reports (Shopify Analytics; Salla Reports, Analytics / التقارير والتحليلات)
note: Q1's M-058. Shopify's admin route analytics, its navigation item, staff permissions, plan line and Admin API resource Analytics; Salla's dashboard app for /reports/analysis, its plan lines for analytics (sales, customers, visits, profits) and its app category Analytics (التحليل و الاحصاء). Children: reports (002), overview dashboards (003), Live View (004), smart analytics (005), and analytics through the API for apps (006).

capability: Reports (Shopify Reports; Salla Reports / التقارير)
note: Shopify's route analytics:reports, gated by the REPORTS permission (Analytics > Reports); Salla's link Reports (/reports), its dashboard app for its report pages, its settings route Statuses included in reports, its plan lines for reports and its staff permissions for each report. Salla's report types (sales, orders, customers, visits, loyalty, wishlists and others) are kinds of report, with permissions only, so they stay here. Shopify's plan line "200+ real-time reports, plus custom analytics" is cited in the parent.

capability: Overview dashboards and store performance (Shopify Overviews, Home; Salla Store performance / ملخص أداء المتجر)
note: Shopify's route analytics:overview gated by OVERVIEWS, and its staff permissions Analytics > Overviews, Home > Home and DASHBOARD; Salla's link Store performance (/reports/performance), its plan lines ملخص أداء المتجر and أداء المتجر, and its staff permissions for the home page's month and orders summaries and alerts. A join on role, a reading: neither platform defines an overview beyond its names.

capability: Live View (Shopify Live View)
note: Shopify's route analytics:live, gated by the store entitlement storefront, and its navigation item Live View. No statement defines it. Salla's cell is none-held.

capability: Smart analytics (Salla Smart analytics)
note: Salla's link Smart analytics (/reports/smart-analysis), not defined. Shopify's cell is none-held.

capability: Analytics and reports through the API for apps (Shopify ShopifyQL for analytics, read_reports; Salla Report Builder / Report Creator)
note: Shopify's API group ShopifyQL for analytics and the read_reports scope "so that your app can read analytics and reporting data" (SH-S-5905); Salla's API folders Report Builder, Report Types and APIs, and its Report Creator, which "enables developers to build custom analytical reports to be displayed on the Salla store dashboard" (SA-S-5146). A join on role, a reading: Salla's reports show in the store's dashboard; Shopify's statements don't say where an app's analytics show. Its parent is a reading: both name the store's analytics.

capability: Notifications: the messages the store sends automatically to customers and staff, with their settings and templates (Shopify Notifications, Customer notifications, Staff notifications; Salla Notifications / الإشعارات, اعدادات التنبيهات)
note: Q1's M-063 joins the two by the term Notifications. Shopify keeps its templates in Settings > Notifications (route notifications, its section Notifications); Salla's link Notifications (/notifications) and its staff permission store_notification_settings_management. Marketing messages are CM-MKT-007.

capability: Staff notifications: notices to the store's staff, such as of new orders (Shopify Staff notifications, Staff order notifications; Salla order_notification / تلقي إشعارات بالطلبات الجديدة)
note: Shopify's route notification-settings:staff is in its section Notifications (SH-S-5209), which puts it under CM-NTF-001. Salla gives it no place of its own: a staff permission in its Orders group (SA-C-040, domain C).

capability: Log of sent messages: the store's archive of the SMS it sent (Salla SMS log / أرشيف الرسائل النصية)
note: Salla puts it under its logs (/logs/messages), not under Notifications, so it has no parent. Shopify's statements hold no log of sent messages.

capability: Message delivery by SMS, email and WhatsApp, and the providers and communication apps that deliver it (Salla Communication Apps / تطبيق الاتصالات, SMS gateways, sender name, SMS balance)
note: Parent: a reading. Salla's Communication Webhooks name each message type a notification ("customer targeted by this notification", SA-S-1660), and a communication app "take[s] over message delivery" (SA-S-0192); the same apps also carry campaigns (CM-MKT-007) and sign-in codes (CM-CUS-010). Shopify's SMS and Email Services are Shopify Messaging's, in CM-MKT-007.

capability: B2B and wholesale selling: selling to business buyers at wholesale prices (Shopify B2B; Salla Wholesale market / سوق الجملة)
note: A join on role, a reading: Shopify sells to companies from the merchant's own store (blended or B2B-only); Salla's wholesale market is a channel (/channel/vendors) where the merchant lists products for retail merchants at special prices. Salla's buying side of the same market (vendors_buy_products) is domain B's CM-CAT-010.

capability: Companies: business buyers with their locations and contacts (Shopify Companies, company locations, company contacts)
note: Shopify's plan line puts company profiles under B2B (SH-S-7212); its admin puts Companies under Customers (staff permission Customers > Companies, SH-I-0928).

capability: Catalogs: product and price lists assigned to B2B buyers or markets (Shopify Catalogs; Salla special prices for retail merchants / تسعيرات خاصة لتجار التجزئة)
note: Parent: Shopify's plan row Shopify B2B counts catalogs ("Up to 3 catalogs", SH-S-7008) and its B2B page names "catalogs with wholesale pricing" (SH-S-7212). Its admin groups Catalogs under Markets (staff permission Markets > Catalogs, SH-I-0963), and its catalogs also serve retail and region markets (SH-S-5101): domain E's markets may cite them.

capability: Apps: the apps a store installs and manages in its admin (Shopify Apps, Apps and channels; Salla My apps, Installed apps / التطبيقات المثبتة)
note: Parent of CM-APP-002 to CM-APP-009. Both platforms keep a store's apps as one admin place: Shopify's Apps section, its apps routes and the staff permissions APPLICATIONS and LIMITED_APPLICATIONS (SH-S-1495, SH-S-5028); Salla's dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-apps at /apps, with My apps at /apps/installed and the permission marketplace_apps_management (SA-S-3541, SA-S-1883, SA-S-2629). Their groupings put the rest under apps: Shopify's Apps section holds App development (SH-S-7143), its Apps and channels permissions hold Approve app charges (SH-I-1008), its help center's apps manual holds Finding and choosing apps and App extensions and functions (SH-I-2101, SH-I-2104), and an app contains its functions (SH-S-0682); Salla's /apps holds the App Store and My apps (SA-S-1884, SA-S-1883), and its App API holds an app's Subscriptions and Settings (SA-S-1077, SA-S-1076). Homonym (notes): Salla's app maker (App Maker, app builder, تطبيق خاص بمتجرك, the publishing policy for Google's and Apple's app stores) is the store's own mobile shopping app, domain E, not an app in this sense.

capability: App store: the platform's marketplace of apps, with its categories and its review of the apps it lists (Shopify App Store, App distribution; Salla App Store, متجر تطبيقات سلة)
note: Shopify's App Store is its own (shopify.com's header navigation, SH-S-2753), reviewed by Shopify (SH-S-0698); Salla's App Store is a dashboard link (/apps, SA-S-1884), and Salla's team reviews, accepts or rejects apps (SA-S-0023). The store's terms for listed apps are here (Salla's App Store policy, SA-C-175); its rule that listed apps bill through the platform is in CM-APP-003. App distribution (Shopify's choice between the App Store and custom distribution, SH-S-2852, SH-S-0692) is here; custom distribution is cited in CM-APP-009.

capability: App charges billed through the platform: the platform bills the merchant for an app and keeps a share for itself (Shopify app charges, Shopify App Pricing, Billing; Salla App Subscriptions, payment through Salla / العمولات والدفع)
note: M-010 is a difference of grain: Shopify keeps app charges (SH-C-019) apart from partner payouts (SH-C-169), and Salla keeps both in SA-C-195. This capability is the charge: billed on the platform's own invoice or through the platform, with the platform's share. The payout of the developer's share, as a partner's finances (Shopify's SH-C-169; Salla's Payouts, Billings, Operation records and Billing System Salla partners), is left to area PTN, which a later batch of this part takes (notes).

capability: App lifecycle events: the platform notifies an app when it is installed, uninstalled, authorized or updated, and when its trial or subscription changes (Shopify app/uninstalled, app_subscriptions/update, App Events API; Salla App Events)
note: Both platforms name the events by the app's lifecycle in a store (Shopify app/uninstalled and app_subscriptions/update, SH-S-1153, SH-S-1156; Salla app.installed, app.uninstalled, app.subscription.started, SA-S-1649, SA-S-1569, SA-S-1572). Both also place app events on the partner's side: Salla's App Events are partner portal events (SA-S-5093), and Shopify's App Events API is in its Partner API (SH-I-0075, in SH-C-168, area PTN). I put the capability under apps, which its events are about, and not under the partner programme, whose capability doesn't exist yet in this part (notes).

capability: Functions: app-written functions that the platform hosts and calls itself, within its own processing or on a store's events (Shopify Functions; Salla App Functions)
note: M-070, one to one. Shopify's functions customize its backend logic and Shopify invokes them within the customer journey, never by URL (SH-S-0681, SH-S-0683); Salla's run when events occur in a store, fully managed by Salla, some of them synchronous and blocking (SA-S-0187, SA-S-0190, SA-S-0189). The function APIs for single features (Shopify's discount, delivery, payment and validation functions) are in the domains of what they customize (C and D, under also); this capability is functions as such.

capability: App UI in the admin: an app's own pages and extensions inside the merchant's admin (Shopify App Home, Admin UI extensions, Polaris; Salla Embedded SDK)
note: Parent of CM-APP-007 and CM-APP-008. Shopify keeps both forms in one concern (SH-C-164: Admin action, Admin block, App home, Admin link, Polaris), so it lands here; Salla's Embedded SDK (SA-C-197) is the iframe form only, so it lands in CM-APP-007. Other surfaces for apps' UI (checkout, customer accounts, POS, the theme) are in the domains of those surfaces.

capability: Embedded app page: an app's own page shown inside the admin, in an iframe or as an extension (Shopify App Home; Salla embedded app pages, Embedded SDK)
note: Joined on role (a reading): Shopify's App Home, its app_home target and its App Home (iframe) API (SH-S-2182, SH-I-0054), and Salla's third-party application running in an iframe in the Merchant Dashboard through the Embedded SDK, with the dashboard's /embedded and /{app-name} apps (SA-S-0197, SA-S-3585, SA-S-3581). Neither side defines the other's term.

capability: Admin UI extensions: an app's blocks, actions, print actions and links on the admin's own pages (Shopify Admin UI extensions: admin_block, admin_action, admin_print, admin_link)
note: Shopify only so far: extension targets that put an app's functionality on core admin pages (SH-S-0711), such as admin.product-details.block.render. Salla's statements hold none found (its cell); its released flag apps-iframe-sections (SA-S-3427) doesn't say where the sections show, so it is cited in the parent.

capability: Custom apps: apps a store develops, or has developed, for itself, not listed in the app store (Shopify custom apps, App development, custom distribution)
note: Shopify only so far: the admin's App development, in its Apps section, with its staff permissions and a plan line (SH-S-7143, SH-S-5038, SH-S-7054), and custom distribution for a specific merchant (SH-S-0693). Salla's statements hold none found (its cell).

capability: App settings: parameters an app's developer defines for the app, held by the platform for each store and read through its API (Salla App Settings, the App API's Settings)
note: Salla only so far: Shopify's statements hold none found. Under CM-APP-001: Salla's App API holds Settings beside Subscriptions (CM-APP-003), and its App Events include app.settings.updated (CM-APP-004). Not an app's page in the admin (CM-APP-007): U-048 apart.

capability: Developer API: the platform's API through which apps read and write a store's data and receive its events, with the conventions common to it (Shopify GraphQL Admin API, REST Admin API (legacy), API usage; Salla Merchant API)
note: Parent of CM-API-002 to CM-API-011. Both platforms list authorization, scopes, rate limits, versioning and webhooks as entries of one list of API resources (Shopify's api-resources: API authentication, Access scopes, Limits, Versioning, Bulk operations, Webhooks; Salla's docs under one folder, 841847: Authorization, Rate Limiting, Versioning, Change Log, Webhooks, Conditional Webhooks). M-073 is a difference of grain: Shopify's SH-C-171 holds the conventions together, so it lands here; Salla's SA-C-201 and SA-C-202 land in CM-API-005 and CM-API-006.

capability: App authorization: how an app is authorized by the merchant to call the API for a store (Shopify API authentication; Salla Authorization, Salla OAuth 2.0)
note: U-046 joined here. Shopify's side is held only as an inventory entry (SH-I-0030); its admin grant routes (app/grant, oauth/request_grant) are SH-C-156's, cited in CM-APP-001.

capability: Access scopes: the parts of a store's data an app may read or write, which the merchant grants (Shopify access scopes; Salla App Scope)
note: M-068. Shopify's scopes that need its approval (SH-C-159) land here, finer than it, with no capability of their own.

capability: Protected customer data: an app's access to buyers' personal data, which the platform approves and bounds (Shopify protected customer data, Level 2 access, read_customer_email)
note: Shopify only so far. Under access scopes: Shopify lists Protected customer data permissions and its read_customer_* scopes among its access scopes (SH-I-2428, SH-I-2472).

capability: API rate limits: how many requests an app may make, and what happens when it exceeds them (Shopify API rate limits, Limits, leaky bucket; Salla Rate Limiting)
note: M-073. Both platforms vary the limits by the store's plan.

capability: API versioning and change log: the platform's versions of its API, when it adds one, and its record of changes (Shopify Versioning; Salla Versioning, Change Log)
note: M-073. Shopify's statements hold no change log found.

capability: Bulk operations: the platform's API for operations over a store's data in bulk, with a webhook topic when one finishes (Shopify Bulk operations, bulk_operations/finish)
note: Shopify only so far.

capability: Webhooks: subscriptions through which the platform sends a store's events to an app's or another service's address (Shopify Webhooks, webhook topics; Salla Webhooks)
note: M-069. Parent of CM-API-009 to CM-API-011. The topics on an app's own lifecycle are CM-APP-004's.

capability: Webhooks set up in the admin: the merchant subscribes an address to the store's events from the admin, without an app (Shopify Settings > Notifications > Webhooks; Salla Developer tools, إرسال الإخطارات لخدمات أخرى عبر Webhooks)
note: Both platforms give it an admin route: Shopify notification-settings:webhooks, Salla /manage/webhooks. Salla gates it by plan.

capability: Conditional webhooks (Salla Conditional Webhooks)
note: Salla only so far, and only by its title: a page of its own in Salla's API documentation list, whose definition the concern map doesn't hold.

capability: Privacy compliance webhooks: topics through which the platform passes data subject requests and erasure to an app, which it must answer (Shopify mandatory compliance webhooks: customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact)
note: Shopify only so far.

capability: Developer tools and documentation: the platform's own tools and docs for building apps and themes (Shopify.dev: Dev docs, CLI, and more; Salla Dev Tools: Partners Agent Kit, Salla Apps Playbook, Salla CLI)
note: Parent of CM-DVT-002. Salla's developer docs have a top-level menu Dev Tools whose children are Partners Agent Kit, Salla Apps Playbook and Salla CLI (SA-S-1176 to SA-S-1179); Shopify's product list names Shopify.dev, "Dev docs, CLI, and more" (SH-I-1990, an inventory entry of SH-C-171). Partners Agent Kit and the Apps Playbook are held only as folder titles, with no definition, so they stay in the parent, not capabilities of their own (my judgment). Not under CM-API-001: Salla's Dev Tools is a menu of its own, not an entry of the API's folder 841847, and Shopify's CLI is in its API resources list only as an unplaced entry (SH-I-0039), which a cell can't cite. Citing SH-I-1990 here and in CM-DVT-002 makes SH-C-171 (landed in CM-API-001) strained, and batch 2's U-047 row for (SH-C-171, SA-C-203) no longer holds (notes, batch 3).

capability: Command-line tool: the platform's CLI for creating and working on apps and themes (Shopify CLI, in Shopify.dev; Salla CLI, Apps Command, Twilight Themes Command)
note: Salla gives it a docs folder of its own, under Dev Tools (SA-S-1179), with its commands as folders of its docs (SA-S-1106, SA-S-1107, SA-S-1109). Shopify's side is only the words "CLI" in the entry Shopify.dev (SH-I-1990); its API resources entry Shopify CLI (SH-I-0039) is unplaced, so not cited.

capability: Partner stores: the stores a partner keeps in its partner dashboard, to build and test on or to prepare for merchants (Shopify Partner Dashboard Stores; Salla Partners portal Stores: Demo Stores, Ready Stores)
note: Parent of CM-DVT-004 and CM-DVT-005. Salla's Partners portal has a menu item Stores (position 27) whose children are Demo Stores, Ready Stores and Store management (SA-S-1931, SA-S-1932, SA-S-1933: each "parent": 27); Shopify's Partner Dashboard has an item Stores (SH-I-2086). The item Stores itself (SA-S-1930) is placed in no concern, so not cited. Store management is SA-C-013's (domain A, partner access to a merchant's store), not cited. Joined on role: neither side defines the other's term (notes).

capability: Development stores: free stores the platform gives developers to build and test apps and themes before launch (Shopify development store; Salla Demo Stores, المتاجر التجريبية, devstore)
note: Salla's place: the Partners portal link Demo Stores, /demo-stores, and the dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-devstore at /store-dev. Shopify names "the development store" only in a theme tool's guide (SH-C-158/boundary/SH-S-6300); no place of its own is held.

capability: Ready stores: stores a partner prepares and publishes for merchants, each reviewed by the platform before it is published (Salla Ready Stores, المتاجر الجاهزة)
note: Salla's place: the Partners portal link Ready Stores, /store (SA-S-1932). What a ready store holds, and who buys it, isn't stated beyond its review (SA-S-5111).

capability: Partner programme: the platform's programme for the developers, agencies and marketers who work with its merchants, with its terms and the dashboard where a partner works (Shopify Partner Program, Shopify Partners, Partner Dashboard, Partner Terms of Service; Salla Partners, منصة شركاء سلة, Partners portal, Developer Portal, سياسة الانضمام إلى برنامج شركاء سلة)
note: Parent of CM-PTN-002 to CM-PTN-009. Both platforms keep a partner's work in one dashboard and under one agreement: Shopify's Partner Dashboard (Home, Stores, Payouts, Organization, Partner settings, Dev dashboard: SH-I-2085 to SH-I-2094) and its Partner Program Agreement; Salla's Partners portal (its navigation holds Dashboard, My Services, Affiliates, Influencer, Payments, Employees, Settings: SA-S-1905 to SA-S-1947) and its policy for joining the programme. M-071 is a difference of grain: Shopify's SH-C-168 holds the programme, its terms, the dashboard and the Partner API; Salla splits the partner account (SA-C-204), the contract (SA-C-176) and app events (SA-C-193, in CM-APP-004). The Partner API (SH-S-0838) is cited here; the seed and Shopify's API resources list put it beside the platform's other APIs, so the coordinator may want a child of CM-API-001 for it (notes).

capability: Partner account: the partner's account or organization, with its eligibility, its identity verification, its settings and its employees (Shopify Partner Account, Partner organization, Organization, Partner settings; Salla Personal Identity, Verified, Employees, Settings)
note: Places of its own: Shopify's Partner Dashboard items Organization and Partner settings and the Partner API object Organization; Salla's Partners portal links Employees and Settings and its lists of identity types and statuses. Identity verification and employees are kept here, not as capabilities of their own: only Salla shows either, and both are parts of the partner's account in its portal (my judgment).

capability: Partner payouts: the platform pays a partner what it owes, such as its share of app revenue and its commissions, on a schedule and subject to holds (Shopify Payouts, partner-payouts, Transactions; Salla Payouts, مستحقات المطورين)
note: Both put it in the partner's dashboard: Shopify's Partner Dashboard item Payouts and its organization settings route partner-payouts; Salla's Partners portal link Payouts under Payments. M-010 is a difference of grain: Shopify's SH-C-169 is payouts alone, landed here by the term Payouts; Salla's SA-C-195 holds app charges and payouts, landed in CM-APP-003 by batch 1, its payout statements cited here.

capability: Partner billing: the platform invoices the partner, who sees and pays the invoices in its dashboard (Shopify partner-billing; Salla Billings, Billing System Salla partners, Operation records)
note: Places of its own: Shopify's organization settings route partner-billing, with the same eligibility as partner-payouts (SH-S-5241); Salla's Partners portal links Billings and Operation records under Payments and its docs link Billing System Salla partners. What the invoices charge the partner for isn't stated on either platform (batch 1's gap).

capability: Partner services for merchants: a directory or marketplace through which merchants find and hire partners' services, and partners list and deliver them (Shopify Partner Directory, Expert services fees, Schedule intro call, Bring your own partner; Salla Merchant Services, experts, Services, Orders Center, Service Provider Portfolio)
note: Parent of CM-PTN-006 and CM-PTN-007. Under the partner programme by the grouping both share on the partner's side: Shopify's Partner Directory is set by the Partner Program Agreement (SH-S-0760, partners/terms); Salla's My Services (Services, Orders Center, Service Provider Portfolio) is in the Partners portal. The merchant's side is in each admin: Shopify's plan subscription routes in Billing; Salla's dashboard link Merchant Services at /manage/experts. U-066 joined here.

capability: Agency store-growth programme: the platform assigns a merchant's store, with the merchant's prior consent, to an accredited partner agency, which activates and develops it (Salla اتفاقية الوكالات لتقديم خدمات لتجار سلة, برنامج تسريع نمو المتاجر)
note: Salla's place: its own agreement on partners.salla.com (SA-S-5124). A finer part of partner services for merchants: here the platform assigns the store, rather than the merchant choosing the partner.

capability: Global selling programme for partners: the platform connects partners with merchants expanding abroad, whom they serve with payments, merchant-of-record and other services (Salla global-selling-program, المدفوعات و البيع بالنيابة (MoR))
note: Salla's place: its own page on partners.salla.com (SA-S-5128). Kept apart from Shopify's Managed Markets (SH-C-110, domain E), which Q1 left unclear (U-076): Salla's is a programme for partners, not the platform selling on the merchant's behalf.

capability: Referral programme for the platform's plans: a member earns a commission on sales of the platform's plans it brings, under the programme's terms (Salla برنامج الإحالة لباقات سلة, اتفاقية استخدام التسويق بالعمولة)
note: Salla's place: its own agreement, on salla.com and partners.salla.com (SA-S-2210; SA-S-0019, from partners.salla.com/legal/privacy-affiliate), and a help article. Under the partner programme: the agreement is one of the Partners portal's legal pages, and its terms address "the partner member of the programme" (SA-I-2619). Its earnings are paid to the merchant's wallet (SA-S-5077), so a member can be a merchant (a reading). The same agreement holds the commission clause cited in CM-PTN-009 (SA-S-0043, under SA-C-206's key).

capability: Partner affiliates and influencers: partners take up affiliate opportunities and influencer campaigns in the partner dashboard and earn commissions on the orders they bring (Salla Affiliates, Affiliate Marketplace, Affiliate Orders, Influencer, Campaign Orders, Marketing Tools)
note: Salla's place: the Partners portal menus Affiliates, Influencer and Marketing Tools (SA-S-1915 to SA-S-1925), with the merchant's side in the dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-partner-marketing. Shopify's nearest statements are Shopify Collabs (SH-C-134) and the App Store category Affiliate program apps (SH-C-194), which scope.tsv gives domain D without F under also: not cited here, and U-056 rules both pairs apart (notes).

capability: Workflow automation: automations the merchant builds from triggers and actions, within the store and across its apps (Shopify Flow, Workflow Automation)
note: Only Shopify shows it so far: Shopify Flow, "a free ecommerce automation platform that enables you to automate tasks and processes within your Shopify store and across your apps" (SH-S-0752), with the staff permissions View, create, and delete automations and Manage connections and secrets (category AUTOMATIONS, SH-S-7161, SH-S-7162), the extension targets Flow trigger, Flow action and Flow template for apps (SH-S-2242, SH-S-2240), and the App Store category Workflow automation apps (SH-I-1950). Salla's automatic order features (Auto tags, Auto assignment) and its Conditional Webhooks, the seed's leads for this area, are single features of other capabilities, not a tool for building automations (notes). Homonym risk: Shopify's Create marketing automations (SH-C-129, domain D) is marketing's own, not this.

capability: AI tools for merchants: the platform's AI features in the merchant's admin (Shopify AI-powered tools, AI features in the Shopify admin; Salla AI tools for merchants)
note: Parent of CM-AIA-002 to CM-AIA-004, a grain I chose (notes): Shopify's help center keeps Sidekick and Shopify Magic in one manual section, ai-powered-tools (SH-S-0736's page; SH-S-7488, AI features in the Shopify admin, is on its page shopify-magic), and Salla's one concern SA-C-012 holds its AI Connector, its AI agent app and its AI generators together. No Salla statement groups them: its features are flags and settings, each on its own (a gap).

capability: AI assistant in the admin: an AI agent the merchant works with inside the admin (Shopify Sidekick, AI assistant for commerce; Salla AI agent, @salla.sa/ui-merchant-ai-agent, merchant-multi-agent-assistant)
note: Joined on role, a reading (notes): Sidekick is "an AI-enabled commerce assistant in your Shopify admin" (SH-S-0736); Salla's dashboard app @salla.sa/ui-merchant-ai-agent at /ai-agent (SA-S-3577) and its unreleased flag merchant-multi-agent-assistant (SA-S-3187) are named for an AI agent and assistant for the merchant, never defined. Homonym: Shopify's "commerce agents" (SH-S-0714) act on behalf of buyers, in CM-AIA-005, not this.

capability: AI content generation: text the platform's AI writes for the merchant, such as product descriptions, blog posts and SEO fields (Shopify Magic; Salla ai-description-generator, ai-seo-generator, توليد تحسينات SEO عبر الذكاء الاصطناعي)
note: Shopify Magic generates product descriptions and blog posts in the product and article editors (SH-S-7203, SH-S-7204, SH-S-7206, SH-S-7207); Salla's flags ai-description-generator and ai-seo-generator are unreleased (SA-S-3488, SA-S-3489), and its plan line generates SEO improvements with AI for an extra fee (SA-S-2133, plan سلة برو). Salla's SEO plan line and ai-seo-generator are also statements of SA-C-033 (SEO, domain E); the cells cite SA-C-012's keys.

capability: AI connector: linking an outside AI assistant to the store through an MCP server the platform provides (Salla AI Connector, salla-mcp)
note: Only Salla shows it so far: the setting Salla AI Connector (general/salla-mcp, SA-S-1725), whose ChatGPT step lets the merchant add a custom MCP server from Salla (SA-S-5005), and the released flag salla-mcp (SA-S-3188). Who the connected assistant acts for is not stated. Under CM-AIA-001 because its setting is in the merchant's own settings (a reading). Kept apart from Shopify's UCP-compliant MCP servers, which serve agents acting on behalf of buyers (SH-S-0714, CM-AIA-005): the shared term MCP doesn't show the same object (notes). Q1's M-079 joins it with WooCommerce MCP.

capability: Agentic commerce: buyers discovering and buying a store's products through AI chats and agents, on channels the platform or third parties operate (Shopify Agentic Storefronts, Sell in AI chats, Universal Commerce Protocol, Agentic)
note: Only Shopify shows it so far: Agentic Storefronts "enables buyers to discover and purchase products from eligible merchants from the user interface of certain channels operated by Shopify or third party Shopify partners" (SH-S-0621), the plan line Sell in AI chats (SH-S-7007), the admin's Agentic section at apps/agentic (SH-S-5027), and the Universal Commerce Protocol with Shopify's UCP-compliant MCP servers for commerce agents (SH-S-0714, SH-S-2530). Salla's only UCP term is the unreleased flag ucp-embedded-checkout of SA-C-100 (domain C, without F under also), left uncited (notes).

capability: Apps made by the platform's company: extensions the platform's company makes, sells and supports, in a category of its own in the platform's marketplace (WooCommerce Developed by Woo, Woo extensions)
note: WooCommerce gives it a marketplace category of its own, Extensions > Developed by Woo (WC-C-050/where/WC-S-0697), the dry run's test for a capability. Its parent is CM-APP-002 because the category sits under the Marketplace's Extensions (the category's own path). Shopify's apps made by Shopify (SH-C-156/responsible/SH-S-0738, cited as shows in CM-APP-001) are for the back-fill to read.

capability: Marketplace connection: linking the store to the platform's marketplace account, so that the merchant installs extensions from it, receives their updates and support, and manages their subscriptions from the admin (WooCommerce Connection to WooCommerce.com, Advanced > WooCommerce.com, wccom-site/v3)
note: WooCommerce gives it a settings section (Advanced > WooCommerce.com, WC-S-0027) and an API group (wccom-site/v3, WC-S-0085) of their own. A store the platform hosts, as on Shopify and Salla, may need no such link; whether the anchors show one is for the back-fill.

capability: API response caching: the platform caches its API's responses, under a setting of its own (WooCommerce Advanced > REST API caching, rest_api_caching)
note: WooCommerce gives it a settings section of its own (WC-S-0024). Its feature flag is experimental and off by default (WC-S-5414).

capability: Account-level API: the platform's API over the merchant's account rather than one store, reaching all the account's stores and its control panel users, with credentials and scopes of its own (BigCommerce GraphQL Account API, Account API, account-level API credentials, account_* scopes)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: an API group of its own (Account API [graphql], BC-I-0109) beside the store-level Admin API. Parent CM-API-001 because BigCommerce lists it among its API accounts (BC-S-0302: store-level, app-level and account-level credentials).

capability: Staging environments: environments where a store's updates are tested and previewed, then deployed, without disrupting the live storefront (BigCommerce Staging environments, StagingPro)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: a product line of its own (BC-I-0540). Not a development store (CM-DVT-004): it stages a live store's changes, not a free store for building apps and themes. No parent: no statement groups it under the developer tools.

capability: Commerce-as-a-Service for partners: partner APIs through which a partner offers the platform's stores to its own merchants, creates and onboards them, changes their plans, and may own their billing (BigCommerce Powered By, Beta Powered By, Commerce-as-a-Service)
note: Only BigCommerce shows it so far: an API group of its own (Beta Powered By, BC-I-0115) and a product line. Not partner stores (CM-DVT-003): the stores are the partner's merchants' live stores, which the partner resells.

capability: Import and export of store data: products, customers and orders (Salla Import & export / إدارة الاستيراد والتصدير, Exports / التصدير; Shopify product imports and the Export permissions)
note: Parent of CM-MIG-002 and CM-MIG-003. Neither platform keeps one section for import and export: Salla puts each object's import or export in that object's list (products, customers, orders) and holds them under one staff permission, import_export_management, one flag, impex, and one Merchant API folder, Exports; Shopify puts its product import routes in Products and an Export permission under each object's section. The objects are named in the cells' readings, not split into capabilities, since each object's section belongs to another domain. Homonyms kept out: customs import and export (duties, export control), the export of a customer's personal data (privacy), marketplace order import (channels).

capability: Advanced import (Salla Advanced import / الاستيراد المتقدم, its custom importer)
note: Salla gives it its own link, route and dashboard app (/importer) and permissions apart from import_export_management. The parent is by its own name, an import (إدارة الاستيراد المتقدم), listed in the products list beside Import & export. Salla doesn't say what it imports or how it differs from Import & export.

capability: Export templates (Salla Export templates, for products and orders)
note: Salla's own links put the templates at the products' and orders' exports routes (/products/exports, /orders/exports). What a template holds isn't stated.

capability: Export log: the record of a store's exports (Salla Export log / سجل التصدير)
note: No parent: Salla's route puts it under its logs (/logs/export), beside Activity history (SA-C-010, domain A's audit log), which a parent in this domain can't follow. Homonym: Salla's سجل names both this export log and the activity log (سجل العمليات), and Q1 lists logs as audit logs against system logs (U-044); this capability is neither.

capability: Moving a store from another platform (Salla's store migration service / خدمة انتقال المتاجر من منصات أخرى; Shopify's migrating from QuickBooks Desktop POS)
note: Salla keeps the service apart from import and export: it has its own terms, eligibility, benefits and contracting company. No platform statement puts it under import and export, so it has no parent.

capability: Platform reliability and continuity: staying available under load, through failures, and when a partner fails (Salla استقرار المنصة وجاهزيتها للذروة; Shopify pods and recovery sites)
note: Joined on role, a reading: Salla sells platform stability and readiness for peak as a plan line, and Shopify's engineering statements describe isolated pods, each with a recovery site. Neither defines the term. What happens when a partner fails (SA-C-235) sits here because no platform gives it a place of its own (convention 2); its statements are each about one kind of partner.

capability: Service status page (Salla's status page)
note: Salla's status page lists components with their state (Merchant APIs; Store APIs, SA-C-101, is domain E's). The concern map holds no Shopify status page.

capability: Export and import of store configuration (WooCommerce Blueprint)
note: Its own section under Settings > Advanced, 'Blueprint (beta)' (WC-S-0028), with its own export route (WC-S-5451) and import checks (WC-S-5448, WC-S-5449). Its imports can change settings (WC-S-5450), so it is about the store's configuration, not the products, customers and orders of CM-MIG-001; no statement puts it under import and export, so it has no parent. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Hosting of the store: the environment the store runs on (WooCommerce hosting environment, hosting provider)
note: WooCommerce's Server Recommendations page asks the merchant to verify their hosting environment (WC-S-0642), and its privacy policy names 'your hosting provider if your site is not hosted by Automattic' (WC-S-0503). Not CM-OPS-001 (reliability and continuity). A lead for the back-fill: Shopify's plan line Unlimited web hosting (SH-C-036/decides/SH-S-7032; SH-C-036 is domain E and names G under also). WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Store status: the system status report and tools (WooCommerce Status: System status, Tools)
note: WooCommerce's admin page WooCommerce > Status, with its tabs System status and Tools, and its own system-status and system-status-tools REST APIs (WC-S-0045, WC-S-0036, WC-S-0037, WC-S-0120, WC-S-0121). Homonym: not CM-OPS-002, the platform's service status page; 'status' names the store's own report here. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Store logs: the entries the store's logger records (WooCommerce Logs)
note: Under CM-OPS-004 by WooCommerce's own grouping: the Logs tab is under Status ('WooCommerce > Status > Logs', WC-S-0920; WC-S-0038). Homonym: not an audit log of staff activity (Shopify's MerchantAuditLog, Salla's Activity history, domain A; U-044), and not Salla's Export log (CM-MIG-004). WooCommerce's Remote Logging, which sends error logs to WooCommerce, lands here strained. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Feature settings: features the merchant enables or disables, experimental ones included (WooCommerce Features)
note: Its own section, Features, under Settings > Advanced (WC-S-5432), defined by WooCommerce as 'the WooCommerce features that can be enabled and disabled by admin users' (WC-S-5433), each definition with is_experimental and enabled_by_default (WC-S-5434). The anchor read Shopify's betas and Salla's released flags as scoping the features they gate, not as capabilities; they are leads for the back-fill to read against this definition. WooCommerce only so far.

capability: Mobile app for managing the store, with push notifications (WooCommerce mobile app)
note: WooCommerce's onboarding task 'Get the free WooCommerce mobile app' (WC-S-0422), its push notifications setting for the mobile apps (WC-S-0939) and its mobile-app API routes (WC-S-0203, WC-S-0204). Push notifications are one feature flag (WC-S-5437), not a place of their own, so they stay in this capability. A lead for the back-fill: Salla's plan line تطبيق إدارة المتجر على أجهزة iOS و Android (SA-C-001/decides/SA-S-2082; SA-C-001 is domain A and doesn't name G under also; U-068). WooCommerce only so far.
